text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Yushun Himba (Oaks) just ahead, 
Vivlos was in stable condition and in high 
spirits as she spoiled herself around the 
older sister who came to support her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though it's a grueling 2,400m race, Vivlos 
approaches it with her usual cheerful 
brightness.
